name: shadcn-vue
description: shadcn-vue — the Vue port of shadcn/ui (built on reka-ui, Tailwind v4): all 64 components with their complete Vue source, props, slots and emits, every demo and the reka-ui API, plus blocks, charts, theming, colours and dark mode, installation (Vite, Nuxt, Astro, Laravel, SvelteKit and others), the CLI, components.json, your own registry, forms (vee-validate and Zod) and the MCP server. Ships the shadcn-vue MCP server with it.
